11335.wikitext:
{{External|rs|dw=Dragon_Full_Helm}} {{Infobox Item |name = Dragon full helm |image = [[File:Dragon full helm.png]] |release = [[3 July]] [[2007]] |update = Barbarian Training |aka = DFH |members = Yes |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Wear, Drop |examine = Protects your head and looks impressive too. |value = 150000 |weight = 2.000 |exchange = Yes |id = 11335 |leagueRegion = Kandarin }} [[File:Dragon full helm detail.png|left|170px]] [[File:Dragon full helm chathead.png|left]] The '''dragon full helm''' is a [[helmet]] that requires 60 [[Defence]] to equip. The dragon full helm gives better defence bonuses than its [[Dragon med helm|medium helm]] counterpart. Due to its high price, and lack of prayer or strength bonuses, it is more often used as a sign of wealth, rather than in combat. A dragon full helm can be combined with a [[dragon full helm ornament kit]] to make a gold-trimmed [[dragon full helm (g)]]. This cosmetic enhancement won't change the stats in any way. It is considered a piece of the [[Dragon equipment#Armour|dragon armour]] set. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = 0 |aslash = 0 |acrush = 0 |amagic = -6 |arange = -3 |dstab = +45 |dslash = +48 |dcrush = +41 |dmagic = -1 |drange = +46 |str = 0 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = head |image = [[File:Dragon armour set (lg) equipped.png|150px]] }} ==Products== {{Uses material list|Dragon full helm}} ==Obtaining== The only way to obtain the dragon full helm is by killing [[mithril dragon]]s in the [[Ancient Cavern]]. The helm can be received from mithril dragons directly as a '''very rare''' drop, or from a [[barbarian spirit]] after lighting a [[pyre ship]] with [[chewed bones]] also obtained from mithril dragons. The drop rate of a dragon full helm from mithril dragons directly is 1/32,768 while the drop rate from chewed bones is 1/256. Chewed bones themselves can only be obtained from mithril dragons as an uncommon drop with a drop rate of 3/128. Combining both the drop rate from chewed bones and the drop rate of the helm itself, the effective drop rate of the dragon full helm from a mithril dragon is 1/8,192. ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Dragon full helm}} ==Used in recommended equipment== {{Used in recommended equipment|Dragon full helm}} ==Development history== [[File:Dragon full helm (The Fremennik Isles).png|The early dragon full helm item's model.|thumb|200px]] The dragon full helm was originally intended to release alongside [[The Fremennik Isles]], but it was cut before release for unknown reasons. Despite this, its models remained unused in the game files, referred to as "''fris_dragonhelm''". Like the [[dragon sq shield]], it would have been obtained in halves which would have to be combined in some way. The dragon full helm was given a new model when it was released a few months later with the original version of the [[Barbarian Training]] miniquest and the [[Ancient Cavern]]. This variant of the '''Torva full helm''' is an unobtainable version of the regular [[Torva full helm]], which resembles its appearance prior to the 3 August 2023 graphical update.

The [[Torva_armour#Appearance|graphical update to Torva armour]] was done with the reasoning that it was not "consistent with Old School's art style", and a non-trivial number of players disagreed with said change, mostly due to nostalgia towards its iconic appearance in its original release in ''RuneScape 2'' in 2011.

As such, this item was released as a compromise to allow the third party client [[RuneLite]] to use the assets for various plugins which changed the appearance of the player character (such as [https://runelite.net/plugin-hub/show/fashionscape Fashionscape] and [https://runelite.net/plugin-hub/show/weapon-animation-replacer Weapon/Gear/Animation Replacer]), although other players would not be able to see said player overriding their appearance.
